text: perfect for my adhd brain. it breaks a task in multiple small sub-tasks so it makes it easier to start. it even understands very specific work related tasks, like design or 3d modelling, or dealing with shipping documents etc, and tells you what to do and where to start and this made my life a lot easier. Inside the app it sets a timer for the entire task but unfortunately it doesn't set a timer for each sub-task with small breaks. but you can do that with the pomodoro timer on the web version.
author: cristina pavel
developer_reply:
Thank you so much, Cristina! I'm really glad the step-by-step breakdowns make starting easier, even for work as specific as 3D modelling and shipping documents. A timer for each sub-task with short breaks is a great idea, and I plan to add it soon.

Andrei

text: i like how easy it is to record my daily to do list and helps me break it down into bite size tasks
author: Bri Camille
developer_reply: Thanks so much, Bri! I'm glad Recordo makes it easy to capture your to-do list and break it into bite-size tasks. If there is anything that would make it even better, I'd love to hear it at dev@recordo.app. Andrei

text: actually like this app, its helpful at giving you that gentle reminder to do something you told yourself you would do. you can set daily reminders. being autistic and potentially adhd this is perfect.
author: Steph Donnelly
developer_reply: Hi Steph, thank you — really glad Recordo is helping in a gentle, useful way. That kind of support is exactly what I wanted the app to feel like. I really appreciate you taking the time to leave this. Andrei

text: Don't think I can do without this app now, it's so useful. The AI integration makes it really useful for quick notes and reminders and I love how I can ask it to change something quickly and it just does it. I also love the coach to help breakdown and get started with tasks and the timer built in is really handy and I love that I can choose a countdown or stopwatch. Thankyou for this app!
author: Jodie Price
developer_reply: Thanks Jodie, I really appreciate this. I'm glad the AI, coach, and timer are fitting into your day so well. Messages like this mean a lot — thanks for using Recordo. Andrei

text: I was able to find the manual task creation which makes this so much easier once the free AI messages runs out. Thank God too for the no ads for every new tasks created as well
author: Miracle Achebe
developer_reply: Hi Miracle, thanks so much for the review, and feel free to send any further feedback anytime!

author: Marta Gomez
developer_reply: Thanks a lot, Marta — really glad Recordo has been so helpful. I really appreciate you taking the time to leave a review. — Andrei

text: this app feels like its fishing for certain affirmative phrases from you based on how the Ai acts. I didnt find it easy to use and had to "affirm" with the Ai several times trying to add a task (i never did get it to make the task). Needs more work before its functional if its not a scam but the idea is interesting.
author: Theia Withersilver
developer_reply:
Theia, I am really sorry you had a bad experience. The app is designed to help to capture thoughts and tasks quickly. I can see that you were able to add some tasks, though I can't see the details of your communication with AI. If you could send the screenshots or more details to support@recordo.app , that would help tremendously.

Thanks,
Andrei

text: The cute squirrel coach is fitting for how ADHD minds can be so chaotic. This app is a task manager & accountability partner that breaks tasks down into bite-sized pieces, staying with you & celebrating completion. It even checked me for going off on a tangent lol, unlike others that enable distraction. Only knocked a star off bc it seems like a newish app & more fitting for a limited free tier or lifetime pay option vs. regular payments w/o having enough time to integrate it into my life 1st.
author: J
developer_reply: Thanks, I really appreciate the thoughtful review. I’m glad the coach and task breakdowns are helping. AI is expensive to run, so the free usage has limits. Andrei

text: this app has helped me organize my thoughts. it has been amaizing!!!
author: Annalee Thompson
developer_reply:
Thank you so much, Annalee! Really happy Recordo is helping you stay organized. If you ever have ideas or feedback, I'd love to hear them!

Andrei

text: can't really give a proper review because I was way too distracted by the US date format. Please give the option to change the date format!! I cannot use this app effectively when having to do the US to the-rest-of-the-world date conversion!!
author: Willow Kai
developer_reply:
Hi Willow,

Thanks for your feedback. This is now fixed in the latest version (2.4.4) - task view displays readable date like "Feb 25, 2026". Please let us know if it works, and kindly consider updating the rating.

text: Found the free version pretty useless as I could only enter 5 to-dos in one day which really makes the free version futile, or at least for someone with a lot in their head to organise
